description: DOCS-1 allowlist for scripts/quality/check-doc-references.py: names a doc legitimately uses that do not live in the tracked tree. Each entry needs a reason. frozenCount counts ignored values (a prefix entry counts once) and may only be lowered, in the commit that removes the entry; an entry nothing matches fails the check.

ignore.reason: The user's own app is scaffolded OUTSIDE this clone (`npdev init` refuses to scaffold inside it), so every `../my-app/...` path in a quickstart is a path in the reader's tree, not ours.
Gradle build output of the reader's generated app (`build/libs/FinalExec-<version>.jar`); the version is the generator's, the directory exists only after the reader builds.

Example domain names the prose invents to explain a concept (an invoice app, a support desk, a library catalogue). They are the READER's model names, deliberately not identifiers in the platform source. TriageAssistantCapability.java is the illustrative file name for the example capability.
Illustrative file name of the example `triageAssistant` capability in the user manual; it is the reader's source file, not one of ours.
